title: Identifier
description: An opaque, unique identifier for an object in the TIER-Graph. Identity is NEVER derived from a mutable label; implementations MUST use opaque identifiers (UUIDs, deterministic hashes, URNs, etc.). The value is treated as an opaque string by the core: no structure is required or interpreted. In this specification's examples, URN-like values are used purely to aid manual tracing.
